response.sql: WITH account_orders AS (SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) as order_count FROM account a LEFT JOIN `order` o ON a.account_id = o.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(order_count) as total FROM account_orders), shares AS (SELECT account_id, order_count, CASE WHEN (SELECT total FROM total_count) > 0 THEN CAST(order_count AS REAL) / (SELECT total FROM total_count) ELSE 0 END as share FROM account_orders), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares), above_avg AS (SELECT account_id, order_count, share FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM overall_avg)) SELECT SUM(order_count) as total_orders, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share) - (SELECT avg_share FROM overall_avg) as avg_distance_above_avg FROM above_avg;
